project: Reduced-Scale Reproduction and Ablation Study of Barlow Twins on CIFAR-10
author: Khagesh Ranjan
institution: Rajiv Gandhi Institute of Petroleum Technology (RGIPT)

hardware.gpu: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5050 Laptop GPU (8.55 GB VRAM)

bt_s0.description: Standard cross-correlation objective (invariance + 0.0051 * redundancy reduction). Total pretraining time: 120.2 minutes (7,211.15s supported by manifest.json; 50 epoch_seconds sum = 7,201.20s). Peak VRAM: 537 MB.

no_rr_s0.measurement_type: directly measured across 50 logged epochs (resumed session from epoch 38)
no_rr_s0.description: Redundancy reduction removed (lambda = 0.0). In this reduced-scale setup, removing redundancy reduction substantially reduced downstream discriminability despite preserving high numerical feature rank (508/512). Total pretraining time: 93.1 minutes (5,587.64s sum of 50 epochs; resumed session 21.0 min / 1,260.28s). Peak VRAM: 602 MB (537 MB initial).

fixed_s0.description: The tested static-threshold configuration produced rank-0 collapse, showing that this particular thresholding strategy failed to maintain a useful representation (constant hinge threshold T=0.05^2). Total pretraining time: 76.4 minutes (4,581.24s). Peak VRAM: 537 MB.

scalar_s0.description: Standard BT with globally weakened lambda=0.001. Total pretraining time: 87.0 minutes (5,218.23s). Peak VRAM: 537 MB.

noise_s0.description: The noise-aware pilot underperformed standard Barlow Twins in this reduced-scale setup. Its adaptive threshold weakened some off-diagonal penalties; however, it remained stronger than globally reducing lambda. Total pretraining time: 88.3 minutes (5,297.05s). Peak VRAM: 537 MB.
